task.title: Calibrate the pressure sensor on test rig TR-2
task.shortdesc: Engineering procedure for the test lab. Run it before each test campaign, and after you replace any sensor. Fictional sample: don’t use it on real equipment.

ul.li: You’ve stopped the rig, and the line is at atmospheric pressure.
The reference gauge has a valid calibration certificate.
You have the calibration sheet for the campaign.

prereq.note: Don’t open the sensor housing. Calibration uses the console only.

step.cmd: On the rig console, open Sensors, and then select the pressure sensor.
Select Calibrate, and then select Zero.
Apply the first test pressure with the hand pump, and then wait until the reading is stable.
Enter the value from the reference gauge in Reference, and then select Record.
Repeat the last two steps for each pressure on the calibration sheet.
Select Finish, and then write the result on the calibration sheet.

result.p: Each reading is within 0.5 % of the reference gauge, and the console shows Calibrated with today’s date.

p.b: If a reading is out of tolerance

postreq.p: Stop the procedure, tag the sensor as out of service, and tell the lab supervisor.
